layout.name: lag
layout.about: slack − HW/LW, hours, M2, depth-averaged along-axis current (−3.1…+3.1; 0 = standing, ±3.1 = progressive)

layout.name: cur_m2
layout.about: M2 tidal current amplitude, kt (depth-averaged, along axis)

layout.name: cur_k1
layout.about: K1 tidal current amplitude, kt

layout.name: zeta_m2
layout.about: M2 water-level amplitude, m

layout.name: zeta_k1
layout.about: K1 water-level amplitude, m

layout.name: flood
layout.about: flood direction, degrees true (2° steps): along the principal flow axis, the way the water goes while the local tide is rising or high (standing wave: on the rise; progressive: at HW)

layout.name: ok
layout.about: 1 = tidal current strong enough (M2+K1 ≥ 0.4 kt) and wet all run for the timing to mean anything

packing.overflow: uint32 n, uint32 idx[n], int16 val[n] after the int8 values

ref.label: the ocean entrance off Neah Bay

layout.name: hw_time
layout.about: M2 high water arrives, hours after the ocean entrance (0–12.4)

layout.name: fl_time
layout.about: M2 strongest flood arrives, hours after high water at the entrance (0–12.4)

layout.name: strength
layout.about: peak tidal current (98th-percentile hour), depth-averaged, kt

layout.name: diurnal
layout.about: K1 share of the tidal current, K1/(M2+K1): 0 twice-daily … 1 daily

layout.name: rotary
layout.about: tidal ellipse minor/major: 0 back-and-forth … 1 rotating

layout.name: dominance
layout.about: (flood − ebb)/(flood + ebb) peak speeds: + flood-dominant, − ebb-dominant

layout.name: res_s_u
layout.about: net drift, surface, east, kt

layout.name: res_s_v
layout.about: net drift, surface, north, kt

layout.name: res_d_u
layout.about: net drift, depth-averaged, east, kt

layout.name: res_d_v
layout.about: net drift, depth-averaged, north, kt

layout.name: shear
layout.about: rms surface − depth-averaged current, kt

layout.name: eddy
layout.about: share of hours spinning (Okubo–Weiss < 0 and |ω| > f)

layout.name: spin
layout.about: mean ω/f in those hours: + anticlockwise, − clockwise
